block.description: Terraform provider for managing FeatBit through its documented public REST API.

attributes.name: access_token
attributes.description: FeatBit personal or service API access token. May also be set with `FEATBIT_ACCESS_TOKEN`; service tokens are recommended for CI/CD.

attributes.name: api_url
attributes.description: FeatBit API base URL. May also be set with `FEATBIT_API_URL`. Defaults to `https://app-api.featbit.co`. The path may be empty or `/api/v1`.

attributes.name: http_timeout_seconds
attributes.description: Timeout in seconds for one FeatBit HTTP request. May also be set with `FEATBIT_HTTP_TIMEOUT_SECONDS`. Defaults to 30; valid range is 1 through 300.

attributes.name: max_concurrency
attributes.description: Maximum number of concurrent FeatBit API requests. May also be set with `FEATBIT_MAX_CONCURRENCY`. Defaults to 4; valid range is 1 through 32.

attributes.name: max_retries
attributes.description: Maximum retry count for safely retryable reads. Mutations are never retried automatically. May also be set with `FEATBIT_MAX_RETRIES`. Defaults to 3; valid range is 0 through 10.

block.description: Manages a FeatBit Environment through the documented public API.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Environment description. An omitted value canonicalizes to an empty string.

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: Environment UUID.

attributes.name: key
attributes.description: Immutable Environment key within the parent Project.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Environment display name.

attributes.name: project_id
attributes.description: Immutable parent Project UUID.

block.description: Manages a FeatBit Feature Flag definition through the documented public API.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Immutable Feature Flag description. An omitted value canonicalizes to an empty string.

attributes.name: environment_id
attributes.description: Immutable parent Environment UUID.

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: Feature Flag UUID.

attributes.name: key
attributes.description: Immutable exact Feature Flag key within the parent Environment.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Feature Flag display name. This is the only field updated in place.

attributes.name: variation_type
attributes.description: Immutable variation type: boolean, string, number, or json.

attributes.name: variations
id
attributes.description: Stable variation UUID.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Variation display name.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Variation value, canonicalized according to variation_type.
Immutable ordered Feature Flag variations. IDs are computed deterministically for provider-created flags.

block.description: Manages one FeatBit Group's settings through the documented public API. Group members and Policies are managed by separate binding resources.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Group description. An omitted value canonicalizes to an empty string.

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: Group UUID.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Group display name.

block.description: Manages one exact FeatBit Group-to-Member binding through the documented public API. It owns only the configured pair, not either endpoint or the Group's complete Member collection.

attributes.name: group_id
attributes.description: Exact Group UUID. Changing it replaces the binding.

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: Canonical synthetic binding ID in `<group_uuid>/<member_uuid>` form.

attributes.name: member_id
attributes.description: Exact existing Member UUID. Changing it replaces the binding.

block.description: Manages one exact FeatBit Group-to-Policy binding through the documented public API. It owns only the configured pair, not either endpoint or the Group's complete Policy collection.

attributes.name: group_id
attributes.description: Exact Group UUID. Changing it replaces the binding.

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: Canonical synthetic binding ID in `<group_uuid>/<policy_uuid>` form.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Exact custom or built-in Policy UUID. Changing it replaces the binding.

block.description: Authoritatively manages one existing FeatBit Member's complete direct Policy set through the documented public API. It never manages inherited Group Policies, Group bindings, or the Member lifecycle.

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: Canonical Member UUID, equal to `member_id`.

attributes.name: member_id
attributes.description: Exact existing Member UUID. Changing it replaces this authoritative direct-Policy set.

attributes.name: policy_ids
attributes.description: Complete unordered set of direct custom or built-in Policy UUIDs. An empty set removes every direct Policy without changing inherited Policies.

block.description: Manages one custom FeatBit Policy and its complete statement set through the documented public API.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Policy description. An omitted value canonicalizes to an empty string.

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: Policy UUID.

attributes.name: key
attributes.description: Immutable organization-scoped exact Policy key.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Policy display name.

attributes.name: statements
actions
attributes.description: Non-empty set of exact case-sensitive actions valid for resource_type.

attributes.name: effect
attributes.description: Exact lowercase effect: allow or deny.

attributes.name: resource_type
attributes.description: Exact lowercase control level: project, env, flag, or segment.

attributes.name: resources
attributes.description: Non-empty set of wildcard or exact-key selectors matching resource_type.
Complete unordered Policy statement set. An empty set removes every statement. Statement actions and selectors are validated against the managed IAM v1 catalog.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Policy ownership type. Managed resources are always CustomerManaged.

block.description: Manages an environment-specific FeatBit Segment through the documented public API.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Segment description, canonicalized to an empty string when omitted and updated in place.

attributes.name: environment_id
attributes.description: Immutable parent Environment UUID.

attributes.name: excluded_users
attributes.description: Exact user keys explicitly excluded from the Segment. Ordering is not significant.

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: Segment UUID.

attributes.name: included_users
attributes.description: Exact user keys explicitly included in the Segment. Ordering is not significant.

attributes.name: key
attributes.description: Immutable exact case-sensitive Segment key within the Environment.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Segment display name, updated in place.

attributes.name: rules
conditions
id
attributes.description: Stable condition UUID.

attributes.name: operator
attributes.description: Exact documented Segment condition operator.

attributes.name: property
attributes.description: Exact user property name.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Operator value. Multi-value operators use a JSON string array; IsTrue and IsFalse require an empty string.
Ordered conditions combined with logical AND.

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: Stable rule UUID.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Rule display name.
Ordered Segment rules. Provider-created rule and condition UUIDs are deterministic.

attributes.name: scopes
attributes.description: Exactly one immutable, fully qualified Environment resource RN.

attributes.name: tags
attributes.description: Segment tags. Ordering is not significant.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Fixed Segment type. Managed resources are always `environment-specific`.
